portrait.guidance: The 800×800 standalone avatar uses a rich royal-blue softly textured studio background. Hair begins y≈93 (12%); head center is slightly right of frame center; eyes sit around y≈325 (41%); chin around y≈604 (76%). Head width is roughly 381 px (48%). The body is angled slightly while the face returns toward the camera. An open smile, visible teeth, short beard and casual black collared shirt communicate warmth and accessibility. Soft directional light from image-left illuminates the forehead/cheek with modest shadow on the opposite side. Blue helps the warm face stand out and matches the banner's keyword emphasis; it is not the exact same blue, which adds depth rather than looking like a flat template.
